topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Well, neighbor, you ask a lot, don’t you? The soil’s not easy, you know. Took me years to get it right, adding this and that, tending it just so. It’s not just a patch of earth you’re asking for, it’s a part of my life. The saints alone know how hard the rain’s been, and the sun, it’s scarce the last few seasons. I worry more each year about what the harvest will bring. I’ve my family to think of, and the miller’s still got an eye for what’s owed. I’ll think on it, I will. But don’t be too hopeful, for the land’s not as bountiful as it once was, and I fear for the days ahead.
